_comment: What the nuke turns blocks into at the rim of its crater. Anything not listed becomes basalt.
from: a block id, a #tag, or a list of them. to: a block id, or a list of {block, weight} picked at random by weight.
An exact block beats a #tag. Tags are tried in file order. Blocks from mods that are not installed are skipped.
Add your own file in data/<your namespace>/avp_human/nuke_conversions/, or replace this one at the same path.
